source_evidence.title: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering
source_evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/209_Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering.pdf
source_evidence.text:
To verify the constructed KGs indeed encode the neces-
sary information for MD-QA, we randomly sample ques-
tions from HotpotQA and construct KGs over the set of
documents for each of these questions using our proposed
methods. We vary the hyperparameters to control the spar-
sity of the constructed KG and measure how much percent-
age of the supporting facts are covered by neighbors of the
seeding passages initially searched by TF-IDF. More details
about the four construction methods and their hyperparame-
ters are included in Section 8.5 in Supplementary. As shown
in Figure 5, as the constructed graph becomes denser, the
chance that the neighboring node passages hit the support-
ing facts increases (i.e., SF-EM increases) although the re-
dundant information also increases (i.e., the precision de-
creases). Given the common keywords shared between one
passage to all other passages are typically far less than the
total number of passages across all documents, the density of
the constructed graph by TF-IDF would be upper-bounded,
causing lower SF-EM (evidenced by SF-EM below 0.7 in
Figure 5 for TF-IDF curve). For TAGME, we empirically
find it identifies a larger quantity of entities mentioned in
a single passage, which leads to a denser graph and causes
the starting SF-EM of TAGME to be already around 0.95.
In addition, since KNN-MDR is pre-trained by predicting
the next supporting facts (Xiong et al. 2020) on HotpotQA,
it achieves better trade-off than KNN-ST where the embed-
dings are directly obtained from the sentence transformer
without dataset-specific pre-training.

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对关系方向、实体角色、任务/实验条件和题干前提。
relation_review.uncertainty: 必要证据不足时明确说明缺口；反例允许纠正前提。

scoring_rules.primary: 逐题审阅目标独立性、分流合理性、拆分是否增添事实或丢任务
scoring_rules.automatic: 路由数、校验通过、子查询数、调用数、Token与耗时；不是语义准确率
scoring_rules.semantic: Codex题面审阅，非独立人工；不使用答案来赋予方法技术关系
scoring_rules.limit: 此24题均为跨论文设计，不能评估简单题误拆率；模型分流本身每题一次调用
scoring_rules.latency: wall time includes loading, route and decomposition in one request

evaluation_config.planned_output: 题面子查询拆分；不运行检索或答案生成

controls.prompt:
你是通用检索问题分流器，只看题面，不回答问题，不用外部知识补论文内容。
判断是否存在多个可独立查证的证据目标，而非按长度、方法名数量判断复杂度。
decision 四选一：no_split=一个整体检索目标；rule=输入提供的确定性规则候选足以表示各自检索目标；llm=有多个目标且需理解指代、跨句归属或隐式描述才能拆；unclear=题面不足以确定安全拆分。
比较题常需分别查证各对象；无方法名但明确要求找两类不同材料时也可以拆成描述性子查询，不猜测论文名。
如 rule_candidate 为空不得选择 rule；非空也须检查是否漏重要目标。rule 时 queries 留空，程序采用规则候选。
llm 时输出2至4个能独立检索的简短子查询，每个只包含题面已给的信息，可自然改写和消解明确指代。没有明确归属时不把列举的技术词按论文知识强行配对，可保留共同问题并把未归属文字放 unresolved。
no_split或unclear时queries为空，保留原题。quotes是支撑判断或拆分的1至4条连续题面原文，必须逐字存在；reason简短解释目标结构，不能说明论文答案。unresolved记录尚未解决的题面歧义，可为空。所有子查询仅用于补充检索，原题始终保留。只输出JSON。
controls.runtime_input: question + generic rule candidates only; no catalog, references or case id
controls.baseline: Rule label = original question retained without splitting
controls.treatment: Local-LLM label = generic router: no_split / rule / llm / unclear; validation failure keeps original
controls.no_anchor: not a gate; descriptive search targets allowed
